t: The Scanner scans a section of the world and stores the result in a Shape Card.
扫描器将扫描世界中某一区域，并将结果存入塑形卡片中。
Put an input Shape Card in the top-left slot. It controls the size and offset of the area to scan.$(br2)Press $(thing)Scan$() to write the result to the Shape Card in the bottom-left slot.
将输入塑形卡片放入左上角槽位，它将控制待扫描区域的尺寸与偏移量。$(br2)点击$(thing)扫描$()，即可将结果写入左下角槽位的塑形卡片中。
